models_evaluated: CLOT model refit to CHD cohort
CLOT model updated with CHD-specific features (CPB time, STAT Mortality Category, BMI)

links.outcome: AUROC of original vs locally refit CLOT model in CHD subpopulation
links.effect: Original AUROC 0.801 (0.749-0.850); refit to CHD cohort 0.846 (0.805-0.888); adding cardiac-specific features 0.859 (0.813-0.898), non-significant vs refit (P=.269).
links.quote: The original CLOT model with refit covariate β -values for the CHD cohort demonstrated better fit (AUROC = 0.846 [0.805–0.888]) compared to the original unaltered model.

links.outcome: Discrimination of the general pediatric model when applied to CHD subpopulation
links.effect: AUROC fell from 0.908 (all pediatric patients) to 0.801 in the CHD cohort; refitting improved it to 0.846.
links.quote: Overall, there was a slight decrease in discrimination compared to the CLOT model’s performance for all pediatric patients (AUROC = 0.908[0.896–0.918]; Figure 2 ).

unlisted_practices: Refit general model to subpopulation instead of adding manually collected specialty features to reduce cost

models_evaluated: Original CLOT model refit using the CHD cohort
Updated CLOT model with CHD-specific features

links.effect: Original CLOT AUROC in CHD cohort was 0.801 [0.749–0.850], below reported all-pediatric AUROC 0.907 [0.898–0.918].
links.quote: There is a slight diminishment in performance for the CHD cohort specifically with the unaltered original model (AUROC = 0.801 [0.749–0.850]).

links.effect: Refit model AUROC = 0.846 [0.805–0.888] compared to original unaltered AUROC = 0.801 [0.749–0.850].
links.quote: The original CLOT model with refit covariate β -values for the CHD cohort demonstrated better fit (AUROC = 0.846 [0.805–0.888]) compared to the original unaltered model.

links.effect: Updated cardiac-specific model AUROC = 0.859 [0.813–0.898], a marginal non-significant improvement versus refit, P = .269.
links.quote: This updated cardiac specific model has an AUROC of 0.859 [0.813–0.898] ( Figure 2 ) demonstrating a marginal, but non-significant, improvement from the refit model ( P = .269).

links.outcome: discrimination of original model in congenital heart disease cohort
links.effect: AUROC 0.801 (95% CI 0.749-0.850) in CHD cohort compared to 0.907 (95% CI 0.898-0.918) in general pediatric cohort
links.quote: There is a slight diminishment in performance for the CHD cohort specifically with the unaltered original model (AUROC = 0.801 [0.749–0.850]).
